title: Dimensional doors discs datapack
description: Bring the atmospheric and eerie sounds of the iconic Dimensional Doors mod straight into your world! This vanilla-friendly project adds custom music discs featuring tracks like Creepy, They Stare Back, and White Void.
body:
# Dimensional Doors Music Discs

This project adds beautiful music from one of my favorite mods straight into the game.

> ⚠️ **IMPORTANT: YOU MUST INSTALL THE RESOURCE PACK in download/Supplementary files for the datapack to work!**

I created this mostly for myself to have access to this incredible music even in pure vanilla Minecraft. Another great thing about this datapack is that it is extremely easy to update to the latest versions of the game, without having to wait for a major update of the original mod.

*All assets belong to the Dimensional Doors team — I just wrapped them into a datapack to enjoy this mod in my own adventure!*

That datapack dosen't override any of minecraft song.

---

## How to Obtain

You can get the music discs in a few different ways: via Survival crafting recipes or using commands.

Also, you can update recipes via `/function dd_discs_data:load` - it'll add discs recipes to your book. 

### 🌌 White Void
command: 
`/give @s minecraft:music_disc_11[minecraft:custom_model_data=369003,minecraft:jukebox_playable={song:'dd_discs_data:white_void'}]`

OR (depends of minecraft version)
`/give @s minecraft:music_disc_11[minecraft:item_model='dd_discs:white_void',minecraft:jukebox_playable='dd_discs_data:white_void']`

![White Void Disc Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5630b5f488d4b8eb2d276ad16ac2aedad96a77a4_0.webp)
